topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't believe this. I pour my heart and soul into developing this device, thinking I'm on the verge of something groundbreaking, only to find out some other so-called "innovator" has already patented it. Months, maybe even years of my life, wasted. I did my research, I thought I covered all my bases. How could I have missed this? And now, what am I supposed to do? Tweak it a bit and hope it's different enough? Or just let it go, all that work for nothing? It's not right. I need to figure out my next move, but the options are thin and the frustration is thick.
